articles.title: Microsoft Pays Researcher $4,000 for Discovering Critical VS Code Security Bypass Flaw
articles.summary:
Microsoft awarded security researcher Sam Chen US$4,000 for reporting a flaw in Visual Studio Code that could let an attacker bypass Workspace Trust protections. articles.title: Unpatched Broadcom Wi-Fi Flaw Lets Attackers in Range Run Code as Root on Routers
articles.summary:
A flaw in Broadcom's Wi-Fi setup software lets an attacker within radio range run code as root on Broadcom-based routers, without the network password or any pairing step, security researcher Quentin Kaiser disclosed on October 16.

He showed the attack working against home gateways supplied by three Belgian internet providers, in one case reading the Wi-Fi password off the device

articles.title: Hackers Use Claude, DeepSeek and Grok in AI-Assisted Attacks on South Korean Banks
articles.summary:

articles.title: OpenCode Console Breach May Have Exposed OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google API Keys
articles.summary:
